scenarios.title: Whirlwind driver (mode 2): legs through the pack, none under the life floor, no death
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 30, purse 3000, class skill points by `debug points` (Whirlwind id 151, S skills.txt), field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2 and monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position, encounter and skill: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: Ten Fallen (a pack) beside a clvl 30 Barbarian with Whirlwind at 1 point (reqlevel 30, S skills.txt; no build table learns it, so the point is a SETUP write). Pair: combat.whirlwind-clears.control (knob 0, same setup): no whirl line, no death. U: the main attack of the played hero and whether the right-skill slot holds Whirlwind (the driver casts the row itself); the shadow mode 1 would log `combat move shadow use=whirl`. Lab run: docs/probes/combat-drills-2026-11-27.md.

assert.why: whirl legs > 0 in mode 2 (V marker: whirl.go whirlTick logs `combat move use=whirl`)
no spin under the life floor (whirlAbortLifePct 50 in profiles.json; the leg line carries the life percent)
no death (the format has no min 0 with a positive max)

scenarios.title: Zeal hold in slices: survival runs between slices, a potion is drunk when life drops
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 24, purse 3000, class skill points by `debug points` (no extra points: the build table learns Zeal), field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2 and monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position, encounter and skill: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: Twelve Fallen around a clvl 24 Paladin on the Zealot-lite table (Zeal is held, press row sliceMs 600). The card's oracle (a potion within one poll of the life line during a hold) needs a scripted life drop the scenario format has no verb for: pre.life_pct only sets the start life, so the pack does the dropping. U: both patterns, first live run fixes them.

assert.why: Zeal was the attack (U: the exact attack line; widen after the first run)
a potion was drunk during the fight: survival is not blocked by a hold (needs life to drop; U whether 12 Fallen do it)
no death (the format has no min 0 with a positive max)
